reserveReview.rationale: BiLira states that a customer deposits Turkish lira to an affiliated bank account and BiLira mints an equivalent amount of TRYB. Its current disclosure states that TRYB is redeemable 1:1 for Turkish lira and that reserves are held in Turkish bank accounts; the issuer publishes recurring reports. The reviewed sources support a complete fiat-bank-reserve category but not a bank-by-bank allocation. Lockstep pin 2026-08-08: compositionAsOf anchored to the 21 May 2026 Corpus Denetim examination that latestReport records - the artefact verifies bank-held TRY reserves against supply, which is the record's single composition category; the issuer-disclosure read of 2026-07-14 is retained as corroboration.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Corpus Denetim examination as of 21 May 2026 (TRY reserves held in Turkish bank accounts), corroborated by issuer disclosure
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve category is disclosed as Turkish-lira bank reserves, but the reviewed sources do not name each reserve bank or publish its share.
